known.title: The repaired panel evidence gives C3 it2 a code-96 recall of 0.36, but the measured value is 0.21; 0.36 is the value of C3 it0
known.locator: Research, Decisions 1, Evidence (line 72); Verification Results, Correction to the panel row (line 178); Verification Results, Benchmark table, code-96 row (line 157)
known.summary: Decision 1 and the panel correction now say that the panel with the new skill found 0.36 on code-96, against 0.14 for one reviewer. The table of the plan gives C3 it2 0.21 on code-96 (line 157), and the dev mean of 0.52 in the same correction is true only with 0.21. In .agents/skills/review-benchmark/results.md at repo_ref, 0.36 is the value of C3 it0 (line 67), and the appended correction says 0.21 (line 127). So the repair mixes two iterations, makes the panel gain on code-96 three times larger, and the plan and the results log disagree.
